method: Build the actual diagnostic module as an isolated esbuild IIFE, serve original fixtures under the unchanged packaged CSP, observe each options.report payload and perform a Playwright trusted browser click. The blocked variant explicitly injects a resume rejection; no report payload is fabricated. Shared dist and native source are not used as test outputs.
